data_as_of: Pre-market quotes from StockAnalysis.com quote API and Yahoo Finance v7 (~7:50 a.m. CT Nov 17); futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, oil, gold ~7:39 a.m. CT (Yahoo). Prior closes are Monday Nov 16.
headline: Futures are mixed after Monday's AI-led selloff, with Nasdaq futures edging up and the Dow lower as traders wait for Nvidia's results after the close.
drivers: Futures are mixed after Monday's broad selloff (S&P 500 −1.9%, Nasdaq-100 −2.7%), with Nasdaq futures slightly higher and Dow futures down ~0.9% as Home Depot, UnitedHealth and other Dow names slip. All eyes are on Nvidia's Q3 report after the close, its first since Jensen Huang resigned; interim CEO Colette Kress hosts the call, and Nvidia disclosed it cut its Intel stake, pressuring INTC. Home Depot and Disney both beat but trade lower, JD.com falls 8% despite a profit beat, and optical names (Coherent, Applied Opto, Lumentum) jump on a Reuters report that the US is pressing ahead with curbs on Chinese optical transceivers. Overseas markets were weak: Nikkei −1.3%, Kospi −2.6%, Hang Seng −1.0%, Stoxx 600 −1.1%; Deutsche Bank slides on an FT report about Epstein-linked transactions. Oil is up ~1.4% (WTI ~$87) on Gulf supply risks, the 10-year yield holds near 5.14%, and October retail sales at 7:30 a.m. CT is the main data test; the Anthropic IPO is set for Thursday.
notes: Run started 7:48 a.m. CT; session = PRE-MARKET. Movers use live pre-market quotes vs Monday's close.

Mac browser worked. Universe: Yahoo v1 screener of 2,042 US exchange-listed stocks with price > $5 and market cap > $2B; Yahoo v7 pre-market quotes (only quotes updated in the last hour kept). Pre-market price, % and volume then taken from the StockAnalysis quote API for ~290 names (top/bottom 40 pre-market movers plus the 200 highest-volume names). Yahoo and StockAnalysis agreed within ~0.5 pt except NTRA (+5.7% Yahoo vs +4.0% SA, left out of the tables) and TAC (+5.5% Yahoo vs −0.8% SA on 515 shares, excluded as a thin/stale print).

Rel vol (all tables) = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average daily volume, a time-of-day fraction, not a session-normalized ratio. Leveraged vol_vs_avg = pre-market volume ÷ 10-day average volume (30-day not available).
Most active (shares and dollars) covers only the ~290 names quoted on StockAnalysis, not a full-market scan.

Gap screen applied strictly: the optical-transceiver curbs story is policy/sector news, not one of the listed catalyst types, so COHR/AAOI/LITE are listed under excluded. SLS (+235%, Phase 3 AML data) fails the $2B cap test at the prior close.
Disney: Yahoo's live blog said ~+2% pre-market early, but both StockAnalysis and Yahoo quotes show ~−1.8% to −2.0% at ~7:50 a.m. CT; the live quote is used.

Under-$5 lists from StockAnalysis pre-market gainers/losers (exchange-listed; Yahoo exchange check, no OTC names found), pre-market volume ≥ 100K. Float from Yahoo; reverse-split history beyond today's news not checked.
FNGU underlying % left null (no live NYSE FANG+ quote; FNGS proxy last traded 3:02 a.m. CT).
Economic times are standard release times converted to CT; consensus figures from Yahoo's live blog. Overnight index levels from Yahoo quotes.
No git commands were run; the Mac publish agent handles commit and push.
